user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 333 lux 到 625 lux
期望 温度 处于 24 ℃ 到 27 ℃
期望 声音 处于 89 dB
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() < 333 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() > 625 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() < 333 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() > 625 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() > 27 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_cooling_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() < 24 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_heating_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 89 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_low() xiaomi_television
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 89 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_high() xiaomi_television
IF viomi_hood.reading() >= 0.12 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
